concept.concept: An illustrated tote showing a flat-lay of seasonal vegetables with 'Locally Obsessed' printed in hand-lettered style.
concept.audience: Farmers market shoppers and locavore food culture enthusiasts
concept.rationale: Totes are the quintessential farmers market accessory. Late summer produce season is peak relevance. The design is functional and identity-affirming. Low IP risk and highly giftable.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Locally Obsessed" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a seasonal vegetable flat-lay arrangement. Center composition featuring a tomato, carrot, bell pepper, leafy greens, and zucchini arranged in an organic scattered pattern. Bold simple shapes with clean sharp edges, high contrast screen-print aesthetic. Solid color blocks only—no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Limited palette: forest green, burnt orange, tomato red, golden yellow, and cream. Plain solid cream background, generous margin around design, all elements connected and centered, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: Hand-lettered sans-serif, organic flowing letterforms, positioned arched below the vegetable arrangement in forest green, 5 words maximum

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Locally Obsessed' is a generic descriptive expression commonly used in the farm-to-table and local food movement space. It does not reference any known registered trademark, brand, celebrity, team, character, or protected slogan. The illustrated seasonal vegetable flat-lay concept is likewise generic. No IP conflicts identified. Note: a formal USPTO trademark search is recommended before production as no database search was performed for this review.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads 'LOCALLY OBSESSED' — correctly spelled and matches required copy exactly. Clean flat-style illustration with generic vegetable motifs (tomato, carrot, zucchini, bell pepper, leafy greens) in a retro color palette. No IP concerns, no brand resemblance, no anatomy issues, no rendering artifacts. Suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Farmers Market Tote Bag 'Locally Obsessed' Seasonal Produce Design
listing.description: Carry your farmers market finds in style with this illustrated tote celebrating local, seasonal produce. Hand-lettered 'Locally Obsessed' design showcases vibrant vegetables in a beautiful flat-lay composition. Perfect for weekly farmers market trips, supporting local growers, or gifting to food-conscious friends and family who value fresh, community-sourced ingredients.
